rows.transcript_gb_en_m:
Stand up and stretch your arms up to the sky. Push away any clouds and let the sun shine down on you. Stretch to both sides. Stretch to the front and to the back.

Let your hands hang by your side. Squeeze your shoulders tightly up to your ears as you breathe in, scrunch your eyes, and hold your breath. Release your shoulders as you relax your body.

Relax your arms and let them swing sideways while you turn your upper body. Your arms should gently hit your back as you twist from side to side.

Place one foot in front of the other and make small circles from your ankles – remember to turn to both sides. Do each foot with four circles in each direction.

Now shake your whole body as fast as you can. Shake it up high! Shake it down low! Shake it all around!

Close your eyes and raise your arms slowly above your head as you breathe in. Lower your arms slowly to your side as you breathe out.

Take a moment to reflect on your experience.

Well done! You can do this activity at any time whenever you feel like you need to release stress and energise your mind and body.
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Sekarang, sila berdiri dengan selesa.

Berdiri dan regangkan tangan anda tinggi ke atas, seolah‑olah menyentuh langit. Tolak jauh “awan‑awan” yang ada dan bayangkan cahaya matahari menyinari anda. Regangkan ke kiri dan kanan, ke depan dan ke belakang.

Biarkan tangan jatuh di sisi tubuh anda. Angkat bahu anda rapat ke telinga sambil menarik nafas, kerutkan mata anda sedikit, dan tahan sekejap. Lepaskan bahu perlahan‑lahan dan rasa tubuh anda mula tenang.

Longgarkan tangan dan biarkan ia berayun ke kiri dan kanan sambil anda memusingkan badan. Biarkan lengan anda menyentuh belakang dengan lembut setiap kali anda berpusing.

Seterusnya, letakkan satu kaki di hadapan kaki yang lain. Angkat sedikit kaki tersebut dan gerakkan pergelangan kaki membentuk bulatan kecil. Pusing ke arah jam dan lawan arah jam. Ulang empat kali untuk setiap kaki.

[Berhenti seketika selama 5 saat]

Sekarang goncangkan seluruh tubuh anda sekuat yang anda mahu. Goncang ke atas! Goncang ke bawah! Goncang ke semua arah!

Pejamkan mata dan angkat tangan perlahan‑lahan ke atas sambil menarik nafas. Turunkan tangan perlahan‑lahan ke sisi sambil menghembus nafas.

Luangkan masa seketika untuk rasa apa yang berubah dalam tubuh anda.

Syabas! Aktiviti ini anda boleh lakukan pada bila‑bila masa sahaja untuk melepaskan tekanan atau mahu menyegarkan tubuh dan minda.

🌱 Children have different abilities at different stages of their development. 

⚽ It is important to know what your child can do at their current stage. 

✨ This way, you can help plan activities that match their abilities and help you have realistic courses for them.

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: All children develop at the same speed as each other.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ That is incorrect.

✨ Each child is unique and will develop at their own pace. Some children may develop in some ways faster than others, while some may take more time.

💚 It is important that parents are patient and supportive, recognizing that every child has their own individual path of development. 

❗Remember that issues with your child’s development are not always obvious, and your child’s condition is NOT your fault.

🚩 If you have concerns about your child's development, you should consult with a professional to get support and advice.

quiz_2_question.eng: As children grow up, they may want to try new styles. How can you respond if your child expresses interest to suddenly change their dressing or hairstyle?

quiz_2_option_1_text.eng: Reject all their requests and say it is not necessary.

quiz_2_feedback_1.eng:
❌ Incorrect. 

💚 By warmly asking your child questions about their interests, they will feel comfortable sharing about the influences around them. 

🌷 You can gently give your opinions about their interests. 

⭐ You can also softly advise them on what changes fit your parenting values at home.

quiz_2_option_2_text.eng: Warmly ask more about what influenced their interest to change and why.

section_1_text.eng:
🎨 your child will want to spend time with other children. 
⚽ Support your child to make friends based on their interests - it’s great for them!
💚 Help your child learn about sharing and playing with others in a safe and fun way.

section_2_text.eng:
📖 Your child might have favourite subjects in school. Encourage them to ask questions if something is hard! 
🌱 They may also be interested in religious matters or spirituality. You can support their curiosity!

section_3_text.eng:
📝 your child may begin making their own decisions and will want you to trust them. Listen to what they want and set rules that work for the family. 
🏆 Praise your child when they follow the rules!

rows.image_asset:
At this stage, children start wanting more independence and trust. 🎈

They want to make their own choices and may answer back to show that they know the correct answers. 🎨⚽

At the same time, they will show emotions in their own unique ways. 😃😒😔😣

Here are some tips to support the healthy development of your child at this age. 💚
